title: B1 · L6 — Second conditional
topic: Second conditional: hypothetical present or future
description: El segundo condicional ('if + past simple, would + infinitivo') se usa para hablar de situaciones hipotéticas o irreales en el presente/futuro.

questions.prompt: Sueñas despierto sobre qué harías si te tocara la lotería.
questions.question: Complete: 'If I ___ a million pounds, I ___ a house by the sea.'
questions.explanation: Segundo condicional: 'if + past simple, would + infinitivo' → situación HIPOTÉTICA o improbable en presente/futuro. Error típico del hispanohablante: usar 'would' en la parte 'if' calcando 'Si tendría un millón...' — en inglés eso es agramatical. La 'if' clause SIEMPRE en past simple.
examples: If I had more free time, I'd travel loads more. → hipótesis presente
If she spoke French, she'd move to Paris tomorrow. → deseo irreal

questions.prompt: Le das un consejo a un amigo poniéndote en su lugar.
questions.question: Choose the correct form: 'If I ___ you, I would apologise.'
questions.explanation: En segundo condicional, la forma tradicional y correcta del verbo 'to be' es 'WERE' para TODAS las personas (I were, he were, she were). 'Was' se oye en habla informal pero suena menos culto. La frase 'If I were you' es LA fórmula fija para dar consejos.
examples: If I were you, I wouldn't send that email — sleep on it. → consejo
If she were here, she'd know what to do. → hipótesis con 'were'

questions.statement: The second conditional is used for real, probable situations in the future.
questions.explanation: FALSO. Para situaciones REALES o probables se usa el PRIMER condicional ('if + present, will + infinitivo'). El segundo condicional es para hipótesis, situaciones imaginarias o improbables. Regla mental: si crees que va a pasar → 1st; si es fantasía o poco probable → 2nd.
examples: First conditional (real): If it rains tomorrow, I'll stay in. → probable
Second conditional (hypothetical): If I won the lottery, I'd travel. → improbable

questions.text: If I had more free time, I would learn to play the piano.
questions.explanation: Nota la contracción típica en habla: 'I'd learn' (para 'I would learn'). En inglés hablado 'would' casi siempre se contrae — decir 'I would' completo suena artificial. 'Had more' se enlaza con una 'd' suave. Estructura clásica: 'If + past simple, subject + 'd + infinitive'.
examples: If I had more money, I'd travel the world in a heartbeat. → deseo hipotético
If she had more energy, she'd go for a run every morning. → hábito irreal

questions.prompt: Un amigo te pregunta qué harías en una situación hipotética laboral.
questions.question: Complete: 'What ___ you do if you ___ your job?'
questions.explanation: En preguntas del segundo condicional: 'would + infinitivo' en la principal + 'past simple' en la 'if' clause. Error muy común: usar 'would' en la 'if' clause ('if you would lose') calcado del español 'si perderías'.
examples: What would you do if you found a wallet on the street? → hipótesis moral
Where would you go if you had a whole month off? → deseo hipotético

questions.prompt: Empareja cada parte del segundo condicional con su forma:
questions.explanation: El segundo condicional combina past simple en la 'if' clause con 'would + infinitivo' en la principal. NUNCA uses 'will' o 'would' en la 'if' clause — es agramatical. Con 'be', prefiere 'were' para todas las personas en registro cuidado.
examples: If I won, I'd throw a huge party. → past simple + 'd
If it were sunny, we'd go out. → 'were' formal

questions.prompt: Identifica la frase con segundo condicional.
questions.question: Which sentence expresses an unlikely hypothetical situation?
options: If it rains tomorrow, I will stay home.
If I studied harder, I would pass the exam.
If I have time, I go to the gym.
If she had left earlier, she would have caught the bus.
questions.explanation: 'If I studied harder, I would pass' es segundo condicional (hipotético). Las otras son: (a) primer condicional (real), (c) cero condicional (verdad general), (d) tercer condicional (pasado irreal). Cada uno con su propia estructura y significado.
examples: If I lived in London, I'd speak much better English. → hipótesis presente
If she practised more, she'd improve quickly. → mejora imaginaria

questions.target: Honestly, if I could live anywhere in the world, I'd probably move to a small island in Greece.
questions.explanation: Situación: hablas de sueños viajeros en una cena con amigos. Usa 'could' en la 'if' clause (posibilidad hipotética), 'would' contraído en la principal. Discourse markers 'honestly' y 'probably' suavizan y añaden autenticidad. Fórmula típica para hablar de deseos irrealizables.
examples: If I could speak any language fluently, I'd choose Italian, hands down. → deseo con énfasis
If I could change one thing in my life, I'd travel way more. → hipótesis personal

questions.statement: 'If I would win the lottery, I would buy a house' is grammatically correct.
questions.explanation: FALSO. En la 'if' clause del segundo condicional NUNCA se usa 'would'. Lo correcto: 'If I won the lottery, I'd buy a house.' Este error es TOP-1 en hispanohablantes porque en español decimos 'Si ganaría/ganase la lotería'. Regla de oro: 'if + would' = error casi siempre.
examples: If I won the lottery, I'd travel the world. → correcto
If she got the job, she'd move abroad. → past simple en if clause

questions.prompt: Le sugieres a tu hermana que baje el ritmo.
questions.question: Complete: 'She ___ happier if she ___ a bit more.'
questions.explanation: Segundo condicional: 'would + infinitivo' en la principal + 'past simple' en la 'if' clause. Implica que ella NO se relaja lo suficiente ahora → hipótesis contraria a la realidad presente. La opción D repite 'would' en la 'if', error clásico.
examples: He'd sleep better if he drank less coffee at night. → consejo hipotético
They'd learn faster if they practised every day. → sugerencia irreal

questions.text: If I were you, I wouldn't accept that offer without thinking twice.
questions.explanation: 'If I were you' se pronuncia muy rápido, casi como una sola unidad ('ifi-were-you'). 'Wouldn't' contrae fuerte la /t/. En registro cuidado se prefiere 'were' a 'was' — es marca de nivel B1+/B2. Es la fórmula MÁS usada en inglés para dar consejos.
examples: If I were you, I'd speak to your manager first thing. → consejo directo
If I were her, I'd take that opportunity in a heartbeat. → recomendación fuerte

questions.prompt: Preguntas a un amigo sobre una oportunidad hipotética.
questions.question: Complete: 'If you ___ the chance, ___ you take it?'
questions.explanation: Segundo condicional en pregunta: 'if + past simple + would + infinitivo?'. Sugiere una situación hipotética que no es real ahora. Error típico: mezclar tiempos ('had / will') o repetir 'would' en la 'if' clause.
examples: If you could meet anyone alive, who would you choose? → hipótesis famosa
If you had a superpower, what would it be? → pregunta clásica de hipótesis

questions.statement: The second conditional can also refer to a hypothetical future, not just the present.
questions.explanation: VERDADERO. 'If I won the lottery tomorrow, I'd celebrate' se refiere a un futuro hipotético e IMPROBABLE. La diferencia con el primer condicional está en la probabilidad: 'If it rains tomorrow' (probable) vs. 'If it snowed tomorrow' (poco probable en verano, por ejemplo).
examples: If I got the job next week, I'd be thrilled. → futuro hipotético improbable
If it snowed tomorrow in July, we'd build a snowman. → futuro casi imposible

questions.prompt: Identifica el uso natural y correcto del segundo condicional.
questions.question: Choose the natural use of the second conditional:
options: If it will rain, we cancel.
If I had wings, I would fly to Paris.
If she has time, she would help.
If we would go now, we arrive early.
questions.explanation: 'If I had wings, I would fly' es hipótesis pura (imposible). Errores: (a) 'will' en if clause; (c) mezcla presente + would; (d) 'would' en if clause + presente en principal. Solo la opción B respeta la estructura del segundo condicional.
examples: If I were a bird, I'd fly south for winter — sounds nice, right? → hipótesis imaginaria
If money were no object, I'd travel forever. → deseo irreal

questions.target: Honestly, if I had more time, I'd definitely learn another language — probably Japanese.
questions.explanation: Situación: hablas de metas pendientes en una charla casual. Usa 'honestly' (marca autenticidad), 'd contraído, 'definitely' (refuerza intención) y una concreción final ('probably Japanese'). Fórmula muy natural para hablar de deseos irrealizables por circunstancias actuales.
examples: If I lived closer, I'd definitely visit you more often — I miss you. → deseo + emoción
If I earned a bit more, I'd save loads for travel, honestly. → hipótesis con condicional realista
